facts.text: I asked about major challenges or threats facing Bayer's pharmaceutical division and how Bayer is addressing them.
I asked what specific strategies Bayer is using to address its challenges.
I expressed hope that Bayer is successful in its efforts to tackle challenges.
I hope Bayer prioritizes patient safety above all else.
I asked whether Bayer is doing anything to improve access to its drugs for patients who may not be able to afford them.
I said it is important to trust the companies that produce the medications people rely on.
I said it is great to see Bayer doing its part to improve access to medication for those who may not be able to afford it.
I hope other pharmaceutical companies follow suit to improve access to medication.
